> A small standalone Board that able to connect to various extensions in the future to be able to perform assisting Work for other projects as a little droid like helper. The board itself is a standalone device with expression interface in form of a display, a camera for visibility, a speaker and a powerful enough micro controller to be able to do object detection task simple calculations and other assistance. In the future it should be able to connect to extensions like wheels or other movement, a robot arm or a desktop connection to be able to perform admin tasks in the workflow

## Design

### 2026-10-06 — oct. 5-6: First concepts of "Parrot"

**1.5h**

oct. 5-6: First concepts of "Parrot"

INTRODUCTION (Hello World:D)
Hello guys this is my first journal about my project of designing and building a small helper bot called "Parrot".
A assistant that can help me with completing various trivia tasks.

WHY AM I BUILDING THIS?
I am really not happy with the effectiveness of my workflow and I wanted to change that for a while now. The solution to this problem is a little helper, that can do tasks for me whilst im working. It is a bit like an AI Agent but hell not as advanced. The main focus lies on hardware help but also in the software area it could be of some help.

TABLE OF CONTENT
oct.5
- Thinking about the project and finding an idea worth making as well as creating a core idea
- writing a first rough concept of the project
- creating a repo for the project
- setting up Hackatime (im a newbie :0)
oct. 6
- creating a distraction for the other participants >:D

CORE CONCEPT
Before we continue, I want to explain in more detail the idea of the project and its core features.

As already stated above, i want to create a little assistant to help with my work. For simplification and to make the project not so big and beginner friendly, I am going to start with the brain of the bot and its senses. But it will also receive an extension port. What is this you may ask. Its the key to his mobility and the potential of the project to accomplish different tasks. With it, it can for example connect to a vehicle to move around or perhaps to a robotic arm to clean up my workspace.

The Core idea is to create a modular project with the potential to becoming a great project but also being beginner friendly and simple at the beginning.
